categories.name: 前沿论文
categories.commentary: 今天这批论文集中在具身Agent的自我改进与工具使用评测基准，以及3D生成和扩散语言模型的方法创新。

articles.title: One Basis to Animate Them All: Gaussian Blendshape Distillation for Real-Time Avatars
articles.zh: 一个基座驱动一切：面向实时虚拟化身的高斯混合形状蒸馏
articles.summary: 如果你在做实时数字人或虚拟形象，这套把高斯表示蒸馏成blendshape基座的做法值得一看——一次建模，所有表情都能驱动。
articles.author: Ramazan Fazylov, Stamatis Lefkimmiatis 等
articles.body: 3D Gaussian avatars support fast rendering, however, their real-time animation is often challenged by the costly neural inference. We address this bottleneck and show that the animation of pretrained avatar models can be closely approximated by a linear combination of identity-independent blendshapes. Building on this finding, we introduce GALA (Gaussian Animation via Linear Approximation), a distillation method that replaces per-frame heavy neural decoding with a shallow coefficient predictor and a linear blend. To improve fidelity and reduce memory requirements, we propose to construct the basis using block-local PCA under a rendering-aware metric and a memory budget. Our method learns a shallow MLP network to predict blendshape coefficients and applies to various animation architectures without retraining original models. We validate GALA by accelerating the inference of three distinct avatar models for 3D animation of facial expressions and full-bodies with clothing dynamics. Across these models, our distillation generalizes to held-out identities and reduces CPU animation cost by up to three orders of magnitude while preserving most of the rendering quality. Excellent results of our method confirm the shared linear structure of learned avatar representations and enable highly efficient and accurate animation at frame rates reaching up to 60fps on mobile devices. Project page: https://ramazan793.github.io/gala/
articles.bodyZh: 3D高斯化身（3D Gaussian avatars）虽然渲染速度快，但实时动画常常受限于昂贵的神经推理（neural inference）开销。我们针对这一瓶颈进行了研究，并发现预训练化身模型的动画效果可以通过一组与身份无关的混合变形（blendshapes）的线性组合来高度近似。基于这一发现，我们提出了GALA（Gaussian Animation via Linear Approximation，基于线性近似的高斯动画），这是一种蒸馏方法，用浅层系数预测器和线性混合来替代每帧繁重的神经解码过程。为了提高保真度并降低内存需求，我们提出在渲染感知度量（rendering-aware metric）和内存预算的约束下，使用块局部主成分分析（block-local PCA）来构建基。我们的方法学习一个浅层MLP网络来预测混合变形系数，并且适用于多种动画架构，无需重新训练原始模型。我们通过在三个不同的化身模型上加速推理来验证GALA，涵盖面部表情的3D动画和带衣物动态的全身动画。在这些模型上，我们的蒸馏方法能够泛化到未见过的身份，将CPU动画成本降低最多三个数量级，同时保留大部分渲染质量。我们方法的优异结果证实了所学化身表示具有共享的线性结构，并实现了高效且精确的动画，在移动设备上帧率可达60fps。项目主页：https://ramazan793.github.io/gala/

articles.title: KaliBench: A Fine-Grained Benchmark for Cybersecurity Tool Use on Kali Linux with Runtime-Free Verifiable Rewards
articles.zh: KaliBench：面向Kali Linux网络安全工具使用的细粒度基准，带免运行时可验证奖励
articles.summary: 如果你在训Agent调用安全工具，这个基准不用真跑就能打分，省事但也要留意它衡量的到底是不是实战能力。
articles.author: Pengfei Li, Naufal Suryanto 等
articles.body: LLMs are increasingly applied to cybersecurity workflows, where they are expected to translate analysts' intent into tool invocations. However, existing evaluations focus on knowledge-based assessments or end-to-end agentic tasks, and do not directly measure LLMs' ability to generate executable commands for real-world cybersecurity tools. This gap is critical because cybersecurity operations rely on strict command-line interfaces (CLIs), where minor syntax errors, incorrect flag--value bindings, or argument misordering can invalidate execution. We introduce KaliBench, a fine-grained benchmark and dataset for natural-language--to--CLI translation on Kali Linux, comprising 8,504 query--command pairs spanning 1,642 tools across 23 capability dimensions and 5 security phases. KaliBench is constructed via a manuscript-grounded pipeline with deterministic canonicalization and alias-aware evaluation, enabling precise and reproducible assessment of tool selection and argument construction. To ensure both semantic correctness and practical executability, we develop a multi-stage verification pipeline that combines LLM-based validation, sandboxed terminal execution, and human-in-the-loop refinement. Building on these fine-grained, deterministic signals, KaliBench further enables runtime-free verifiable rewards for training. Across three evaluation modes and 24 configurations of general-purpose and security-focused open-weight models, no open-weight model exceeds 42% exact-command accuracy in the unrestricted setting, highlighting the difficulty of accurate CLI-based cybersecurity tool use without explicit tool hints. We further show that supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards derived from KaliBench significantly improve an 8B model and achieve performance comparable to a 685B MoE model.
articles.bodyZh: 大语言模型（LLMs）正越来越多地被用到网络安全工作流程中，大家希望它们能把分析师的意图转化成工具调用。但现有的评估要么只看知识掌握程度，要么只测端到端的智能体任务，并没有直接衡量大语言模型为真实网络安全工具生成可执行命令的能力。这个缺口很关键，因为网络安全操作依赖严格的命令行界面（CLIs），一点点语法错误、标志和值配对出错，或者参数顺序搞错，都可能导致命令跑不起来。我们推出了KaliBench，这是一个针对Kali Linux上自然语言到命令行翻译的细粒度基准和数据集，包含8504对查询与命令，覆盖1642个工具、23个能力维度和5个安全阶段。KaliBench通过一套基于原始文档构建的流程搭建，配合确定性规范化和别名感知评估，能够对工具选择和参数构造进行精确且可复现的评估。为了同时保证语义正确和实际可执行，我们开发了一个多阶段验证流程，把基于大语言模型的验证、沙箱终端执行和人在回路中的精修结合起来。有了这些细粒度、确定性的信号，KaliBench还能进一步支持训练时的免运行时可验证奖励。在三种评估模式和24种通用及安全专用的开放权重模型配置下，没有任何一个开放权重模型在无限制设置中超过42%的精确命令准确率，这说明在没有明确工具提示的情况下，准确使用基于命令行的网络安全工具相当困难。我们还进一步证明，用KaliBench衍生出的可验证奖励做监督微调（supervised fine-tuning）和强化学习（reinforcement learning），能显著提升一个80亿参数模型的表现，并达到与6850亿参数的混合专家（MoE）模型相当的水平。

articles.title: Reconstruct, Practice, Go Real: Guided Self-Improvement for Embodied Agents
articles.zh: 重建、练习、上真机：具身智能体的引导式自我改进
articles.summary: 如果你在愁具身Agent没数据、真机试错太贵，这条"先重建、再模拟练、最后上真机"的路线给了一个省样本的思路。
articles.author: Yen-Jen Wang, Haozhe Jiang 等
articles.body: Building reliable robot capabilities across diverse tasks requires substantial human effort to develop and maintain skills, design rewards, and integrate perception with control. We present Reconstruct, Practice, Go Real (RPG), a framework for autonomous improvement of robot execution systems without updating model weights. RPG identifies manipulation capabilities in an offline dataset and constructs related practice tasks in simulation. During practice, RPG uses execution feedback, privileged simulator state, and available dataset videos to diagnose failures. It develops new reusable symbolic skills, refines existing skills, and revises the system prompt based on these diagnoses. Cross-task evaluation tests individual candidate changes and merged revisions before they are retained for reuse. At test time, a multimodal LLM uses the resulting system prompt and skill library to coordinate perception and robot control. On held-out initializations of 22 manipulation tasks, RPG improves task success from 28.6% after the first practice round to 95.0% after 15 rounds, outperforming all evaluated baselines, including ASPIRE (75.5%) and CaP-Agent0 powered by GPT-6 Astra Pro (60.0%). After a common calibration and hardware-adaptation procedure, the frozen system succeeds in all 30 physical trials, with ten trials on each of three tasks. Project Website: https://rpg-robot.github.io/
articles.bodyZh: 想让机器人在各种任务里都稳定可靠，得靠大量人工去开发、维护技能，设计奖励，还得把感知和控制接起来。我们提出了一套叫“先重建、再练习、然后上真机”（Reconstruct, Practice, Go Real，简称 RPG）的框架，它能在不更新模型权重（model weights）的情况下，让机器人执行系统自己不断变强。RPG 会先从离线数据集（offline dataset）里找出有哪些操作能力（manipulation capabilities），再到仿真环境（simulation）里搭出相关的练习任务。练习时，RPG 会利用执行反馈、仿真器里的特权状态（privileged simulator state，也就是仿真中才拿得到的完整内部信息），以及手头数据集里的视频，来判断到底哪里出了问题、为什么会失败。根据这些诊断，它会开发新的、可复用的符号技能（symbolic skills），打磨已有技能，还会修改系统提示词（system prompt）。跨任务评估（cross-task evaluation）会把每个候选改动、以及合并后的修订版本都拿去测一遍，只有通过测试，才会被留下来以后接着用。到了测试时，一个多模态大语言模型（multimodal LLM）会用最终得到的系统提示词和技能库，把感知和机器人控制协调起来。在 22 个操作任务的留出初始条件（held-out initializations）上，RPG 把任务成功率从第一轮练习后的 28.6% 提升到第 15 轮后的 95.0%，超过了所有被评估的基线（baselines），包括 ASPIRE（75.5%）和由 GPT-6 Astra Pro 驱动的 CaP-Agent0（60.0%）。经过一套通用的校准和硬件适配流程（calibration and hardware-adaptation procedure）后，这个已经冻结、不再更新的系统在全部 30 次真机试验（physical trials）里都成功了，三个任务各做了十次。项目网站：https://rpg-robot.github.io/

articles.title: ScholarCatalyst: A Benchmark for Retrieving Papers That Inspire New Research
articles.zh: ScholarCatalyst：检索能激发新研究论文的基准
articles.summary: 如果你做学术搜索或推荐，这个基准把"能否启发新想法"当成检索目标，比单纯相关性打分更贴近研究者的真实需求。
articles.author: Sohyeon Kim, Yoonho Lee 等
articles.body: What makes great scientists great? Even as AI systems start to make progress on open problems, scientists remain far ahead of them at sensing which prior idea, buried in an ever-growing archive of research, a new problem needs. To study this skill, we draw on researchers who know firsthand which earlier work advanced their completed projects, with papers serving as pointers to the ideas within. Using our automated pipeline that makes author annotation scalable, we build ScholarCatalyst by having 184 lead authors of 207 recent computer science papers label which candidates did or could have advanced their project, each with a detailed rationale. We introduce a retrieval task with author-provided judgments: given an initial research question, retrieve these papers from only the literature available when the project began. Agentic search does no better than embedding retrieval (0.42 vs. 0.48 Recall@20) despite calling that same retriever as a tool. Even an agent built on Claude Fable 5.1, which may have seen the completed papers during training, reaches only 0.51 R@20. These results highlight the need for new training recipes that equip models with expert intuition for searching broad corpora. We envision ScholarCatalyst as a step toward scientific agents that can take a half-formed idea and point to the prior research it needs.
articles.bodyZh: 顶尖科学家到底强在哪儿？哪怕人工智能（AI）系统已经开始在一些开放问题（open problems）上取得进展，科学家还有一项本事远远领先：面对一个新问题，他们能感觉到，在不断膨胀的研究资料库里，哪个早先的想法才是这个问题真正需要的。为了研究这种能力，我们找了一些研究人员，因为他们最清楚：自己已经完成的项目，到底是哪些早期工作推动了它；而论文就像指针，指向里面包含的想法。我们用了自己的自动化流程（automated pipeline），让作者标注（author annotation）能规模化，然后搭建了 ScholarCatalyst：请 207 篇近期计算机科学论文的 184 位主要作者来标注，哪些候选论文确实推动过、或者本来可能推动他们的项目，而且每条都给出详细理由。我们还提出了一个带作者判断的检索任务：给定一个初始研究问题，只能从项目开始时已经存在的文献里，把这些论文检索出来。结果，智能体搜索（agentic search）并不比嵌入检索（embedding retrieval）更好（Recall@20 是 0.42 对 0.48），尽管它会把同一个检索器当成工具来调用。就算是一个基于 Claude Fable 5.1 搭出来的智能体——它在训练时可能已经见过这些已完成的论文——也只达到 0.51 R@20。这些结果凸显出，我们需要新的训练方案（training recipes），让模型具备在大规模语料库（broad corpora）里搜索时所需的专家直觉（expert intuition）。我们设想，ScholarCatalyst 是迈向科学智能体（scientific agents）的一步：它们能拿到一个半成型的想法，然后指出它需要哪些先前研究。

articles.title: SILSA: Sliding-Window Slice Latents for Topology-Preserving High-Resolution 3D Generation
articles.zh: SILSA：滑动窗口切片隐变量，用于保拓扑的高分辨率3D生成
articles.summary: 如果你被3D生成的高分辨率细节和拓扑崩坏两头夹击，这个切片式隐变量方案值得拿来对比一下。
articles.author: Tianjiao Yu, Xinzhuo Li 等
articles.body: High-resolution 3D generation increasingly relies on voxel latents and multi-stage pipelines that first predict active structure and then synthesize local geometry. While effective, this design fragments continuous surfaces into many local tokens, inflates generation cost, and often weakens topological consistency for thin or highly connected shapes. We introduce SILSA, a topology-aware 3D generation framework that represents shapes with compact sliding-window slice latents. Instead of generating expensive voxel tokens, SILSA uses a fixed set of overlapping slices along the three canonical axes, where each token summarizes a local depth window to preserve cross-sectional continuity and support single-stage rectified-flow generation. A Slice VAE encodes oriented surface samples into multi-axis slice latents and reconstructs them with a sparse volumetric decoder, while a Volumetric Anchor Lattice coordinates directional slice streams through a shared 3D workspace. To preserve structural correctness, we introduce slice-level topology supervision that matches persistence diagrams and aligns Betti transitions across neighboring slices. Experiments show that SILSA improves structural fidelity while substantially reducing generation cost. SILSA improves PSNR by $8.7\%$, coverage by $5.96$ absolute points, and Betti error by $9.2\%$ over the strongest baseline, while using $70.0\%$ fewer tokens than the next-most compact baseline and over $98\%$ fewer tokens than sparse or hierarchical tokenizers, effectively reducing training memory by $40.4\%$ and inference time by $58.5\%$. Qualitative results further show improved preservation of thin structures, repeated components, and long-range connectivity.
articles.bodyZh: 现在要做高分辨率三维生成（High-resolution 3D generation），越来越多人靠的是体素隐变量（voxel latents）和多阶段流程（multi-stage pipelines）：先预测活跃结构（active structure），再合成局部几何（local geometry）。这套办法虽然有效，但它会把连续表面（continuous surfaces）拆成一堆局部 token（local tokens），生成成本（generation cost）被抬高，而且碰上薄壁或高度连接的形状（thin or highly connected shapes），拓扑一致性（topological consistency）常常也会被削弱。我们提出 SILSA，一个拓扑感知（topology-aware）的三维生成框架，它用紧凑的滑动窗口切片隐变量（compact sliding-window slice latents）来表示形状。SILSA 不去生成昂贵的体素 token（voxel tokens），而是沿着三个标准坐标轴（canonical axes）放一组固定的重叠切片（overlapping slices）；每个 token 概括一个局部深度窗口（local depth window），这样能保住截面连续性（cross-sectional continuity），还支持单阶段整流流生成（single-stage rectified-flow generation）。一个切片变分自编码器（Slice VAE）把带方向的表面采样点（oriented surface samples）编码成多轴切片隐变量（multi-axis slice latents），再用稀疏体积解码器（sparse volumetric decoder）重建；同时，一个体积锚点晶格（Volumetric Anchor Lattice）通过共享的三维工作空间（shared 3D workspace）来协调不同方向的切片流（directional slice streams）。为了保证结构正确，我们引入了切片级拓扑监督（slice-level topology supervision），它会匹配持久性图（persistence diagrams），并让相邻切片之间的贝蒂数转变（Betti transitions）对齐。实验表明，SILSA 提升了结构保真度（structural fidelity），同时大幅降低生成成本。跟最强基线比，SILSA 把峰值信噪比（PSNR）提高了 8.7%，覆盖率（coverage）提高了 5.96 个绝对百分点，贝蒂误差（Betti error）改善了 9.2%；它用的 token 比第二紧凑的基线少 70.0%，比稀疏或分层 token 化器（sparse or hierarchical tokenizers）少超过 98%，把训练内存有效降低 40.4%，推理时间减少 58.5%。定性结果（qualitative results）还显示，薄结构、重复部件和长距离连通性都保得更好。

articles.title: VISTA: A Visual Harness for Reasoning in an Interactive World
articles.zh: VISTA：交互世界中的视觉推理测试框架
articles.summary: 如果你在评估多模态模型的推理能力，这个把模型丢进可交互视觉环境的做法，比静态问答更能暴露真实短板。
articles.author: Qiushi Han, Keya Hu 等
articles.body: We show that multimodal models possess strong reasoning abilities and that an appropriate harness can unlock their potential to solve tasks across diverse interactive environments. We introduce VISTA, a visual harness that gives a general-purpose multimodal model long-horizon vision. VISTA allows the model to directly perceive the environment through visual observations and maintains a lossless visual memory that preserves past observations in their original form. The model can actively retrieve these observations and reorganize its visual input as it reasons. On ARC-AGI-3, VISTA improves Claude Opus 5.0's Relative Human Action Efficiency score from 40.68 to a perfect 100.00, with the model completing all 25 public games using 57.4% fewer actions than first-time human participants. VISTA's simple design also allows it to extend naturally to diverse visual environments with minimal adaptation. Across three additional benchmarks covering a diverse range of visual games and puzzles, it substantially outperforms baselines using the same underlying model with minimal harnesses. Our results highlight VISTA's potential as a general-purpose visual harness for advancing multimodal agents in complex visual environments.
articles.bodyZh: 我们证明了，多模态模型（multimodal models）本身就具备很强的推理能力，只要给它们配上一套合适的辅助框架（harness），就能把它们在不同交互式环境里解决任务的潜力真正释放出来。我们提出了 VISTA——一个视觉辅助框架（visual harness），让通用多模态模型也能拥有长时程视觉（long-horizon vision）。有了 VISTA，模型可以直接通过视觉观察来感知环境，并且维护一份无损视觉记忆（lossless visual memory），把过去的观察原封不动地保存下来。模型在推理时，还能主动把这些观察调取出来，重新组织自己的视觉输入。在 ARC-AGI-3 上，VISTA 把 Claude Opus 5.0 的相对人类行动效率分数（Relative Human Action Efficiency score）从 40.68 提升到了满分 100.00，而且模型完成全部 25 个公开游戏时，比第一次上手的人类参与者少用了 57.4% 的行动。VISTA 的设计也很简单，所以它能很自然地扩展到各种视觉环境，几乎不需要额外调整。在另外三个覆盖多种视觉游戏和谜题的基准测试（benchmarks）里，它的表现大幅超过了那些使用同一个底层模型、但只配了最简框架的基线方法（baselines）。我们的结果说明，VISTA 有潜力成为一种通用视觉辅助框架，推动多模态智能体（multimodal agents）在复杂视觉环境里不断前进。

articles.title: FERPO: Forward Entropy-Regularized Policy Optimization
articles.zh: FERPO：前向熵正则化策略优化
articles.summary: 如果你在调强化学习的探索-利用平衡，这个前向熵正则的思路可以拿来试试，纯方法向，没有太多花活。
articles.author: Sebastian Sanokowski, Alireza Sarmadi 等
articles.body: Several state-of-the-art methods for online reinforcement learning in continuous control improve policies using action gradients of a learned critic. However, critics are typically trained to predict returns, and accurate value predictions do not necessarily yield accurate action derivatives, potentially leading to unreliable policy updates. We propose Forward Entropy-Regularized Policy Optimization (FERPO), an on-policy maximum entropy reinforcement learning algorithm that performs policy improvement using critic values without differentiating the critic with respect to actions. FERPO derives an optimal target action distribution from a policy-improvement objective regularized by entropy and Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence. We then fit the actor to this target by minimizing a forward-KL objective, estimated using self-normalized importance sampling (SNIS) with actions drawn from the rollout policy. By limiting the target distribution's deviation from the rollout policy, the KL regularization helps keep these importance weights well behaved. In contrast to reverse-KL objectives, which can favor a subset of the target distribution's modes, the forward-KL objective encourages coverage of multiple high-value modes and thereby promotes exploration. Experiments and ablations on MuJoCo Playground and ManiSkill show competitive performance and sample-efficiency gains. Computational benchmarks also demonstrate faster actor updates than Relative Entropy Pathwise Policy Optimization (REPPO).
articles.bodyZh: 在连续控制领域，几种先进的在线强化学习方法通过利用学习到的评论家（critic）的动作梯度来改进策略。然而，评论家通常被训练来预测回报，而准确的价值预测并不一定能产生准确的动作导数，这可能导致策略更新不可靠。我们提出了前向熵正则化策略优化（FERPO），这是一种在策略最大熵强化学习算法，它使用评论家值进行策略改进，而不对评论家关于动作求导。FERPO从由熵和Kullback-Leibler（KL）散度正则化的策略改进目标中推导出最优目标动作分布。然后，我们通过最小化前向KL目标来使演员（actor）拟合这个目标，该目标使用自归一化重要性采样（SNIS）和从滚动策略中抽取的动作来估计。通过限制目标分布与滚动策略的偏差，KL正则化有助于保持这些重要性权重表现良好。与可能偏向目标分布模式子集的反向KL目标相比，前向KL目标鼓励覆盖多个高价值模式，从而促进探索。在MuJoCo Playground和ManiSkill上的实验和消融研究表明了竞争性的性能和样本效率提升。计算基准还表明，与相对熵路径策略优化（REPPO）相比，演员更新更快。

articles.title: Hierarchical Continuous Diffusion Language Models
articles.zh: 分层连续扩散语言模型
articles.summary: 如果你关注扩散模型做文本生成这条路，分层加连续空间的设计是想同时解决长文本和离散token这两个老大难。
articles.author: Hui Ren, Zihan Li 等
articles.body: Discrete diffusion language models offer a compelling alternative to autoregressive generation for tasks demanding bidirectional reasoning and global constraint satisfaction. Yet they share a structural bottleneck: when decoding in parallel, each token is sampled independently from its marginal, severing the statistical dependencies among the tokens decoded together. Continuous diffusion language models avoid this by denoising a shared continuous state, but their denoiser sees only that state, so nothing ties it to a valid token configuration until it is finally decoded. To address this, we propose Hierarchical Continuous Diffusion Language Models (HC-DLM), which couple discrete token generation with a continuous latent trajectory in a single, principled denoising process, whose training objective is derived from a variational bound on the token likelihood. In contrast to recent methods that attach continuous context to a self-contained discrete chain, HC-DLM makes the latent the only persistent generative state: tokens are read out from it at every step and feed back as a scaffold for the next latent update. On structured reasoning (Sudoku), mathematical planning (Countdown) and language modeling (LM1B), HC-DLM improves over discrete and continuous diffusion baselines at matched model size, in puzzle accuracy on Sudoku and Countdown and in generative perplexity on LM1B. Project page: https://hc-dlm.github.io/.
articles.bodyZh: 离散扩散语言模型为那些需要双向推理和全局约束满足的任务提供了一种很有前景的替代方案，可以取代自回归生成。但它们都有一个结构性瓶颈：并行解码时，每个词元都是独立地从其边缘分布中采样出来的，这就切断了同时解码的词元之间的统计依赖关系。连续扩散语言模型通过去噪一个共享的连续状态来避免这个问题，但它们的去噪器只能看到这个状态，所以在最终解码之前，没有任何东西能把它和一个有效的词元配置绑定起来。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了分层连续扩散语言模型（HC-DLM），它将离散词元生成与连续潜在轨迹耦合在一个单一的、有原则的去噪过程中，其训练目标是从词元似然的变分下界推导出来的。与最近那些将连续上下文附加到自包含离散链上的方法不同，HC-DLM让潜在状态成为唯一持久的生成状态：每一步都从中读出词元，并将其作为下一步潜在更新的脚手架反馈回去。在结构化推理（数独）、数学规划（倒计时）和语言建模（LM1B）上，HC-DLM在相同模型规模下优于离散和连续扩散基线，在数独和倒计时的谜题准确率以及LM1B的生成困惑度上都有提升。项目页面：https://hc-dlm.github.io/。
